one_liner: y_fire is the FIRMS outcome on D+1; ERA5 predictors end at D-5.

target.positive_definition: at least one qualifying FIRMS pixel in the cell on label_date

timing.naming_note: In this archive, feature_end_date is the ERA5 source day D-5, not forecast day D.

s5p_2021.s5p_measurement_encoding: all numeric S5P measurements are zero

training_contract.missing_value_note: Stage C feature columns contain no NaN or infinity; source absence is encoded with availability indicators and numeric placeholders.
training_contract.class_imbalance_note: The training positive rate is 1.406%; use class weighting or an imbalance-aware loss and evaluate with PR-AUC in addition to ROC-AUC.

audit_findings.detail: 7392 test rows covering 2025-12-21 through 2025-12-31 are marked S2-available with lag 16-26 days, exceeding the documented 15-day limit.
6720 training rows covering 10 days in 2020 are marked S5P-available with lag 3-7 days, exceeding the documented 2-day limit.
3360 training rows for 2019-01-01 through 2019-01-05 have s2n_available=0 but retain nonzero S2 measurements.
Small negative ERA5 soil values occur in 46002 swvl1 rows, 45232 swvl2 rows, and 21039 soil_moisture_index rows.
s5n_s5p_aai_std and s5n_s5p_co_std are constant zero and should be removed or ignored.
The existing numerical_nextday runner expects feature_end_date=D, an era5_source_date column, and separate tune/calibration files; this archive uses eo_asof_date=D and a combined val file.
